text:
The net yield of substrate-level ATP in glycolysis is **2 ATP per glucose**, from 4 ATP produced minus 2 consumed at hexokinase and phosphofructokinase. Starting from glycogen, glycolysis yields **3 ATP** because glycogen phosphorylase releases glucose-1-phosphate without spending an ATP at the hexokinase step, so the team note's "2 from glucose and 3 from glycogen" option is the correct one.

CONFIDENCE: 96
